results.title: The Tent
results.overview: Tahir and Zuhra are a young married couple who, although they married out of love, decide to divorce due to minor family disputes. After receiving the court's divorce decree, they feel relieved and immediately go in different directions, looking forward to their new, free lives. But fate has an unexpected surprise in store for them: no matter where they sleep, every morning they wake up in a traditional wedding tent, a symbol of the first night, set up in an art museum. In desperation, they turn to a psychic to put an end to this mystery.

results.title: Lord Curzon Ki Haveli
results.overview: Follows four Desis as they meet in an unplanned dinner. Rohit tells his guests upon arriving that there is a corpse in the trunk. The not-so-innocent joke will change their lives that very night.

results.title: Bia
results.overview: As a doctoral student, she investigates women's rights to expression within peasant protests; through this engagement, she seeks the strength to dismantle the fundamental structures of patriarchy, addressing issues such as marriage, family, and the valuation of these women's labor and freedom. This is a fictional film rooted in many real-life moments — shot at the MST’s (Landless Workers' Movement) Normandia encampment in Caruaru — that blends fiction with documentary elements.

results.title: Fatal Fraud
results.overview: When a private investigator is hired to find a missing girl whose identity has been stolen by a con artist, he must race against time to locate her before it's too late. As he delves deeper into the case, he uncovers a web of secrets.

results.title: Apple Music Live: Fred again..
results.overview: Party into the new year with the DJ, who played an electrifying set in Dublin during his USB002 show, accompanied by his friends and guests.

results.title: Cuming Out
results.overview: Kennedy’s desire for a heteronormative experience sees her embark on a one-night stand. What could possibly go wrong?

results.title: Rhythm Is a Dancer
results.overview: Ro, a young woman with a dwindling dance career, returns home after many years to meet her biological father for the first time. Born to Susan, a mother who chose artificial insemination, Ro grapples with the complexities of her unconventional family dynamic. After taking a new job, she forms an unexpected bond with three spirited octogenarians who help her reconnect with her family, her roots, and herself.

results.title: Nosotros, mi papá y el perro
results.original_title: Nosotros, mi papá y el perro
results.overview: Second feature film by Pablo Arturo Suárez.

results.title: Sun Ra: Do the Impossible
results.overview: A biographical, musical, illuminating journey into the work and vision of Sun Ra, exploring his jazz roots, endless innovations, and ceaseless artistic and social quests.

results.title: Tonic
results.overview: A barfly jazz pianist must commit murder in exchange for his drug debt to a crocked cop.

results.title: The Way We Talk
results.overview: Wolf, born into a deaf family, embraces sign language with confidence despite obstacles in life; Sophie, having received a cochlear implant at a young age, continuously strives to be seen as "normal" despite having a "deaf accent." Alan, with a cochlear implant like Sophie, is capable of both spoken language and sign language; he advocates for diverse modes of communication within the deaf community. Bound by love and friendship, the three embark on a self-discovering journey that is not without its moments of pain.

results.title: Happy Ending
results.overview: A couple attempts to revive their spark at a "happy ending" massage parlor, but they're trapped inside when a murderous client's obsession with a masseuse turns violent, thrusting everyone in the spa into a fight for survival.

results.title: Message in a Bottle
results.overview: A renowned sommelier finds a way to communicate with her past self in an attempt to correct the mistakes that have shaped her life. However, each message sent triggers unexpected consequences, altering not only her present but also the fates of those around her. What begins as an opportunity to make amends for the past becomes a race against time to prevent everything from spiraling out of control.

results.title: Pompei: Below the Clouds
results.overview: Naples faces dual volcanic threats from Vesuvius and Campi Flegrei. Amid increasing tremors, archaeologists work as residents live anxiously, haunted by Pompeii's fate while emergency services strain.

results.title: Miles, Morale and Memories: Bob Hope and WWII
results.original_title: Miles, Morale and Memories: Bob Hope and WWII
results.overview: A 2025 PBS documentary narrated by Gary Sinise, marking the 80th anniversary of the end of World War II. It examines the extraordinary wartime contributions of legendary entertainer Bob Hope and his troupe of performers.

results.title: Sub Rosa
results.overview: The film tells the story of sisters Sarah and Elizabeth, whose lives are forever changed by Elizabeth's mysterious pregnancy and its aftermath, leading to a poignant revelation years later that tests the depths of their bond and resilience

results.title: Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan: At a Confessional
results.original_title: 岸辺露伴は動かない 懺悔室
results.overview: While on vacation in Venice, author Rohan Kishibe is mistaken for a priest and hears the confession of a horrific crime. Rohan becomes engrossed in this mysterious confession and uses his special ability to turn people into books and read their memories and experiences…

results.title: Love Guru
results.overview: Sophia, a talented architect has been dreaming of marrying her true love. But when a new man walks into her life, everything changes. Torn between family expectations and the stirrings of her heart, Sophia embarks on a journey of self-discovery, love, and difficult choices.

results.title: The Rules of Art
results.overview: Jonathan, an expert in luxury watches, leads a gray and monotonous life until he meets Eric, a charming conman and dealer in stolen goods. Fascinated by his lifestyle, Jonathan is drawn deeper and deeper into the world of criminal transactions. The situation spirals out of control when the virtuoso thief Joe joins them. In 2010, the trio committed one of the most daring robberies in history - they stole five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse and Modigliani from the Museum of Modern Art in Paris.
